# EchoSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("EchoSoundEffect")`

Repeats the sound after a delay, more quietly each time, like a canyon or a tunnel.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Delay` | `number` | `0.3` | read/write | The time before each echo, in seconds, from 0.01 to 2. |
| `DryLevel` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The level of the original sound, from 0 to 1. |
| `Feedback` | `number` | `0.4` | read/write | How much of each echo is echoed again, from 0 to 0.95. At 0 there is a single echo; higher values give a longer series. |
| `WetLevel` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The level of the echoes, from 0 to 1. |
